annotations.title: Explain a spirit, ingredient or bar term

description: Use this when the user asks what a spirit, liqueur, mixer or other cocktail ingredient is, what to use instead of one, or what a bar term means or how a technique works, for example "What is mezcal and what can I use instead?", "What can I use instead of Aperol?" or "How do I dry shake?". Covers ingredients (taste, what it is made from, typical ABV, styles, substitutes including zero-proof ones, cocktails that use it) and bar terms such as a technique, glass, tool or drink style (definition, how-to steps, related terms). Returns the matching fixmeadrinkapp.com ingredient or glossary page. It does not give health or nutrition advice.

term.description: The thing to explain, e.g. "mezcal", "Aperol", "dry shake", "coupe glass"
